faq: Do you work from a Figma file or only from a template?

Either. Send a Figma, Sketch or image design and we build it as drawn. If you have no design, pick a Webflow template or describe the look you want, and we set one up around your logo, colors and fonts.
Whose Webflow account is the site built in?
Yours. You create the workspace and add us as a member, or we guide you through it. We never ask for your password. Your Webflow site plan and hosting are billed by Webflow directly to you.
Can I edit the site myself afterwards?
Yes. We build with the Editor in mind, so text, images and CMS items can be changed without opening the Designer. Every order ends with a short written guide that shows you how.
Do you write the copy and make the images?
We place the text and images you send. Where content is missing we use clear placeholder text and mark it in the handover, so you know exactly what still needs adding before launch.
desc:
A Webflow site build turns your design, a chosen template or a simple brief into a finished, responsive website in your own workspace. Ecom Swift LLC builds clean pages, CMS content and working forms, then hands over a staging link and an Editor guide.

## What is a Webflow site build?

A Webflow site build is the construction of a new website inside Webflow, from layout to launch checklist. Pages are assembled in the Designer with a clear structure of sections, classes and breakpoints. Repeating content such as blog posts or projects is set up in the CMS, and forms are connected so enquiries reach you.

You can start from a design file, a template you like or a short brief. The aim is a site that looks right, works on every screen and can be edited by you afterward.

## Why build quality matters more than the first impression

A site can look finished and still be hard to live with. Messy class names, deeply nested elements and one-off styles make every future change slower and riskier. A page that works on a laptop but fails on a tablet creates support work after launch.

A careful build avoids those traps. Consistent class naming, reusable sections and sensible breakpoints keep the project readable. Whoever edits it next, you or another developer, spends time on content instead of fighting the layout.

## How a good build helps visitors and your business

Visitors feel quality even when they cannot name it. Pages load quickly, text is readable, buttons are where they expect and forms confirm that a message was sent. Those small things build trust, which supports enquiries and sales.

Structure also helps the business side. Headings follow a logical order, images have alt text, and each page has a title and description, so search engines can read the site. A CMS means new posts or projects can be added in the Editor without design changes. The result is a site that stays useful as you grow.

## What a ready-to-launch build includes

- Pages built from your design file, template or brief.
- Responsive layouts across desktop, tablet and phone.
- A tidy class structure and reusable sections.
- CMS collections for blog posts, projects or team members where needed.
- A contact form connected to your inbox, with a clear success message.
- Light scroll and hover interactions kept simple.
- Search titles and meta descriptions on each page.
- Analytics and a cookie banner where your region requires them.
- A staging link for review before anything goes public.
- A launch checklist and a guide to editing in the Webflow Editor.

## How we build

We confirm the page list and the source of the design, then set up the project in your workspace. Global styles come first: colors, typography, spacing and buttons. Pages are assembled from those shared parts, then tested at each breakpoint.

The Basic package builds a small site from your design or one chosen template, with a contact form. The Standard package builds a fuller site with a CMS collection, basic interactions, search titles and a staging review. The Premium package builds a larger marketing site with several CMS collections, custom interactions, analytics, a cookie banner, an Editor guide and a period of fixes after launch. An extra page, a blog setup and a basic speed pass are available as add-ons. Writing copy and creating images are not part of the package unless agreed.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send the design file, template link or brief at the start.
- Prepare text and images before the build begins.
- Give feedback on the staging link in one organized round.
- Check every form on your own phone.
- Choose a Webflow site plan that suits your needs.

**Avoid:**
- Changing the page list halfway through the build.
- Sending low-resolution logos and photos.
- Approving a site you have only seen on a desktop screen.
- Adding new features after the staging review without discussing them.
- Publishing before testing forms and links.

## Who this service is for

This service suits new businesses launching their first site, designers who have a finished mockup but need it built, and owners who picked a template and want it set up properly. It also fits teams moving from a spreadsheet of content to a real, editable site.

## What we need from you

Send your design, template link or brief, your logo and any text and images you have. We never need your password. The site is built in your own workspace, with us added as a collaborator, so you own the project from day one.
